name: @bobcgn/skill-central
stderr:
Usage: skill-central [options] [command]

Local MCP Server for cross-IDE AI skill distribution

Options:
  -v, --version               output the version number
  -h, --help                  display help for command

Commands:
  mcp                         Start Stdio MCP Server (for IDE integration)
  board [options]             Start web dashboard (default) or show terminal
                              table (--cli)
  init                        Scaffold .skills/ directory with sample
                              definitions
  add [options]               Create a new skill definition file (auto-selects
                              layer from tags)
  list [options]              List all loaded skills (filters: --layer, --type,
                              --tag)
  show <id>                   Print full details + prompt body of a single skill
  remove [options] <id>       Delete a skill definition file (use --layer if id
                              exists in multiple layers)
  validate <files...>         Parse and validate one or more skill definition
                              files
  doctor                      Scan layers for missing dirs, parse errors, id
                              collisions, and orphan backups
  install [options] <source>  Install a skill from github: or npm: URL (P10 adds
                              npm)
  update [options] [id]       Re-fetch installed skill(s) from their source.
                              With no id, updates all.
  uninstall [options] <id>    Remove an installed skill (file + lock entry)
  register [options] [ide]    Automatically register skill-central into IDE MCP
                              configurations (claude, cursor, windsurf, cline).
                              Omitting [ide] will auto-detect and register in
                              all found.
  help [command]              display help for command
